description: NREL Annual Technology Baseline (ATB) electricity cost projections from the official open-data release on the OEDI data lake (latest release found automatically): LCOE ($/MWh), CAPEX, overnight capital cost, fixed/variable O&M, capacity factor and more, per technology and resource class, yearly to 2050-2060, for a scenario, financial case, tax-credit setting and cost-recovery period. US-focused, real-dollar values as published by NREL. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

allClasses.description: true to return every resource class, default only NREL's representative (default) class

case.description: Financial case as published (ATB 2025: Exp or R&D; older: Market or R&D). Default: Exp, else Market

crpYears.description: Cost recovery period in years, 20 or 30 (default 30)

metric.description: One of LCOE, CAPEX, OCC, Fixed O&M, Variable O&M, CF, Fuel, Heat Rate, FCR, WACC Real (default LCOE)

taxCredits.description: true to use the tax-credit case (ITC/PTC), default false

technology.description: ATB technology, e.g. UtilityPV, LandbasedWind, OffShoreWind, NaturalGas_FE, Nuclear, Geothermal, Utility-Scale Battery Storage, CommPV, ResPV, Hydropower, CSP, Biopower, Coal_FE

year.description: Single projection year (e.g. 2030). Omit for the full yearly series

name: energy_nrel_atb_cost_benchmarks
title: Energy Nrel Atb Cost Benchmarks
